assets.name: Credentials and restricted diagnostics
assets.objective: never reach browser, fixture, telemetry, or audit

trust_boundaries.rule: typed request reference and safe status projection; no cookie or business payload reuse
read-only start; exact principal, capability, resources, environment, plan hash, and expiry
typed plan-bound invocation only; browser never invokes
source, observed_at, expiry, classification, and schema validation
server redaction and allow-listed fields before serialization

threats.abuse_case: A Workspace, Deal Room, or MCP credential is presented to an operations route.
mitigations: dedicated origin, audience, and cookie namespace
wrong audience returns 401 without resource disclosure

threats.abuse_case: An attacker sets ?profile=joe or supplies actor, role, risk, environment, or capability fields.
mitigations: default deny when no exact grant matches

threats.abuse_case: An agent approves its own plan or grants itself a production capability.
mitigations: human approver identity differs from executor
agent grants contain no approve or grant capability

threats.abuse_case: An approval for an earlier revision is used after a material plan change.
mitigations: material change creates a revision and invalidates approval

threats.abuse_case: A valid capability for rehearsal/service A is applied to production/service B.
mitigations: exact resource and environment grant match

threats.threat: Prompt or output injection becomes authority
threats.abuse_case: Collector text or agent output embeds instructions that a router executes.
mitigations: no arbitrary command or generic MCP route
capability derives only from server policy

threats.abuse_case: A DSN, token, private key, raw client record, or unrestricted diagnostic reaches fixtures, DOM, telemetry, or audit.

threats.threat: Stale or missing evidence displayed as Healthy
threats.abuse_case: A cached successful check survives collector failure and is rendered as current health.
mitigations: stale or missing required input forces Unknown

threats.abuse_case: A refreshed browser retries or completes a server operation based on cached UI state.

threats.threat: Capability inheritance by replacement agent session
threats.abuse_case: A new task or executor inherits an old task's production grant.
mitigations: capability binds one session and expires
replacement session requires a new grant

threats.abuse_case: Events are reordered, edited, deleted, or linked across different plans so execution cannot be proven.

threats.threat: Business record leakage into operations plane
threats.abuse_case: Client payload or transcript content is copied into an operations work request or audit event.

acceptance: Every threat has an asset, boundary, abuse case, mitigation, evidence reference, and executable test ID; unresolved threats default deny.
